TR 6 + CC 6 + LR 6 + GRA 7 = 25; 25 ÷ 4 = 6.25, which rounds up to **6.5** (`contexts/01-band-descriptors/scoring-rules.md` §3). **Your route to 7.0 is shorter than it has ever been:** 7 + 7 + 6 + 7 = 27 ÷ 4 = 6.75, which rounds up. You have held TR 7 and CC 7 before (W5, W6), and GRA 7 has just arrived. You need to recover two criteria you have already stood on, not acquire three new ones.

## CONVERGENCE: REFINING

Codex and I now agree on TR 6, LR 6, GRA 7, the overall 6.5, and the top three priorities; this round I also dropped one of my own CC arguments and corrected two citations, so the gap has narrowed rather than rotated. One substantive disagreement remains — **CC 6 versus CC 7** — and it is not cosmetic, since it decides whether cohesion is finished or is the writer's next cheapest band. I converge the moment codex shows substitution on the head noun that I have missed, or shows why the panel's own CC 6 for W9 does not bind an essay with the same two faults and a narrower device range.
